learning_outcomes.text: Knows and can apply the principles of design for manufacturing and design for assembly.
Knows and can apply the principles of machine safety (Risk Assessment).
Applies manufacturing constraints to the design of mechanical elements and groups.
Selects materials for the mechanical project.

Intervenes effectively and transmits relevant information, appropriate to the situation. Plans communication: generates ideas, searches for information, selects and orders information, creates outlines, determines the type of audience, communication objectives,... Drafts documents with appropriate format, content, structure, linguistic correctness, and register, and illustrates concepts correctly using conventions: formats, titles, captions, legends,... Their presentations are properly prepared, using strategies to present and deliver oral presentations (audiovisual aids, gaze, voice, gesture, time control,...).
Actively participates in the distribution of responsibilities and tasks based on the potential of each team member.
Develops strategies to involve the team in achieving objectives.

Participates actively and shares information, knowledge, and experiences. Carries out their individual contribution within the planned time and with available resources. Accepts and complies with group rules. Actively collaborates in team work planning, task distribution, and required deadlines.
Develops strategies and methods to constructively resolve interpersonal conflicts.

Analyzes the work or professional environment in the field of study (environment). Designs academic and professional insertion itineraries (itineraries). Identifies their own learning process (learning). Deepens self-knowledge in academic, work, or professional areas (self-knowledge).

Selects a procedure from those proposed by the professor. In each case, knows how to formulate the appropriate questions to resolve doubts or open questions and has criteria in searching for information.

Presents expected results in the appropriate manner according to the given bibliography and within the foreseen time. Analyzes their limitations and possibilities to carry out their task. Decides how to manage and organize work and time. Has criteria regarding their learning process and learning needs.
Knows the main inequalities and discriminations that occur between men and women and understands their causes (Equality).

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the design of mechanical elements and groups
Material selection for mechanical project: Mechanical and functional properties. Selection tools and databases.
Machine safety: Risk assessment. Regulations and CE marking.
Leadership, entrepreneurship, and professional orientation: Team management. Business model development.
teaching_methods: Explanation of the most relevant aspects of the syllabus
Development of a project based on an existing or new industrial or technological equipment, according to given specifications.
Realization of practical exercises with design and simulation software.

assessment_methods.method: Reports and presentations of design and simulation practices through ICT in computer labs

assessment_rules: This course, due to its eminently practical nature, has only one assessment session, and students cannot request an additional exam session. The minimum weighted average score for the exams is 4 points. The minimum score for the Project is 4 points. The fraudulent use of AI in evaluative tests is prohibited and will result in a failing grade for that activity.
